objects.name: All-in-one
objects.description: The 2007–18 machine behind the screen — sized entirely by its panel, with a slot-loading drive, a chin or a bezel, and a foot, an arm or nothing at all.

params.label: Panel
params.help: The diagonal. Everything else on this machine follows from it.

params.label: Bezel
params.help: Round the sides and the top. It got thinner every year.

params.label: Chin
params.help: The deeper band under the panel, where the board and the badge went.

params.label: Thickness
params.help: At the thickest point. A slot-loading drive needs about 30.

params.label: Tapered back
params.help: Thick in the middle where the board is, thin at the edges.

options.label: None — it was the first thing to go
Foot — a plate and a neck
Arm — a hinged one, off a slab
Easel — a leg folded out of the back

params.label: Keyboard and mouse
params.help: The slim wireless pair these came with.

objects.name: AT desktop
objects.description: The 1984–93 desktop with the monitor on top — case sized from the board standard, the card height and the drive bays, with full-height or half-height 5¼" openings and ISA cards.

params.label: Board
params.help: The standard the case is built around. Everything else follows from it.

params.label: Cards fitted
params.help: Video, disk controller, serial and parallel, and whatever else the machine needed.

params.label: Lid off
params.help: Takes the lid and the near side away, and builds the board, the cards, the supply and the drive cage.

params.label: Bay openings
params.help: Full height is the early one: two of them filled the front. Half height came in around 1985 and doubled what would fit.

params.label: Bay columns
params.help: Side by side across the front. Each column widens the case by 158 mm.

params.label: 3½" floppy drive
params.help: The later fitment, in a frame that filled a 5¼" opening.

params.label: Hard disk
params.help: In a bay of its own, with a lamp on the front and no opening.

params.label: Tape streamer
params.help: For the nightly backup, in the last free opening.

params.label: Key lock
params.help: The barrel lock that froze the keyboard. Nobody knew where the key was.

params.label: Turbo button and clock display
params.help: A clone fitment, and the number on it was decorative.

objects.name: Chair
objects.description: A chair for the table — four seat shapes with the same moulded edges, seven backs from ladder to upholstered, five leg profiles including cabriole, optional arms, and the same fanciness dial.

params.label: Seat width
params.help: Across +Z, at the front.

params.label: Seat height
params.help: Floor to the top of the seat. 450 sits at a 750 table.

params.label: Edge profile
params.help: The same profiles the table edge and the stair treads use.

options.label: Open — posts and a crest only

params.label: Back height
params.help: Above the seat.

params.label: Rake
params.help: How far the back leans away from vertical.

options.label: Cabriole — curved, on a pad foot

params.label: Splay
params.help: How far the feet stand outside the seat.

params.label: Back legs run up into the back
params.help: Off puts the back posts on the seat instead, as a Windsor does.

options.label: H — side rails and a centre rail
Box — a rail on all four sides
Double — two rails across the front

params.label: Arm height
params.help: Above the seat.

options.label: Squab — a cushion laid on top
Drop-in — a pad inside a seat frame

params.label: Fanciness
params.help: 1 beads the seat edge, 2 shapes the back boards and pads the feet, 3 adds corbels and scrolls the arms, 4 turns finials and rings, 5 carves the crest and buttons the upholstery.

objects.name: Fractal tree
objects.description: A seeded recursive tree — branch count, angle, taper and droop shape the habit, with leaf and fruit or blossom models on the outer growth.

params.label: Trunk length
params.help: Length of the first limb; the tree ends up taller than this.

params.label: Branch thickness
params.help: Diameter at the base of the trunk.

params.label: Taper
params.help: Thickness kept at each split.

params.label: Levels
params.help: Depth of recursion.

params.label: Branch frequency
params.help: Side branches at each split.

params.label: Length ratio
params.help: Length kept at each split.

params.label: Apical dominance
params.help: How strongly a leader carries straight on. High makes a conifer, low a spreading crown.

params.label: Twist per level
params.help: Rotation between successive whorls. 137.5° is the golden angle.

params.label: Droop
params.help: Positive weeps down, negative sweeps up.

params.label: Seed
params.help: Same seed, same tree.

params.label: Leafy levels
params.help: How many of the outermost levels carry leaves.

objects.name: Gaming tower
objects.description: The 2002–12 black ATX tower — sized from its board and bays, with a double-height graphics card, PCI and PCI Express, a windowed side panel and the fans to go with it.

params.label: Board
params.help: Sets the footprint, the height of the case and how many slots there are.

params.label: Graphics card
params.help: Double height with its own cooler, and it takes two slots.

params.label: Other cards
params.help: Sound, network, capture, or a second graphics card.

params.label: 5¼" openings
params.help: 41.3 mm of case height each.

params.label: Optical drives
params.help: DVD, then Blu-ray. The same tray from the outside.

params.label: Fan controller
params.help: In a 5¼" opening, with dials and a temperature readout.

params.label: Card reader
params.help: In the 3½" opening the floppy used to have.

params.label: Hard disks
params.help: In the internal cage — 26 mm of height each.

params.label: Solid state drive
params.help: A 2½" drive on a bracket. The late fitment.

objects.name: Home micro
objects.description: The 1977–85 wedge with the keyboard built in — sized by its key pitch and layout, with a cassette deck, cartridge slot and edge connector rather than bays and cards.

options.label: Chiclet — flat rounded caps in a sea of plastic
Rubber — one moulded mat, dead to the touch

params.label: Columns
params.help: Keys across the main block. Ten was a calculator; fifteen took a full alphabet row.

params.label: Key pitch
params.help: Centre to centre. A typewriter is 19.05; below about 16 you are hunting and pecking.

params.label: Numeric keypad
params.help: Four more columns on the right, and a wider case to hold them.

params.label: Moulding around the keys
params.help: Plastic between the key block and the edge of the case.

params.label: Front lip height
params.help: How thick the case is at the front edge, where your wrists rest.

params.label: Slope
params.help: The rake of the top. The back is as tall as this makes it.

params.label: Moulded ribs
params.help: The ridges across the back of the top, hiding the vents and stiffening the lid.

params.label: Cassette
params.help: Tape was the storage. Either a deck moulded into the case or a socket for one on a lead.

options.label: Socket at the back for a deck on a lead
Deck built into the right of the case

params.label: Cartridge slot
params.help: A letterbox in the back for a ROM cartridge.

params.label: Expansion edge connector
params.help: The bare fingers of the board, brought out through a slot. Everything hung off this.

options.label: Aerial socket — tune the television in

objects.name: Integrated micro
objects.description: The 1977–83 all-in-one — a tube, a case moulded around it, and the tape deck or twin floppies built into the same box. Sized by the tube it was built around.

params.label: Tube
params.help: Diagonal. Nine inches was the usual; twelve made a much bigger box.

options.label: Amber — easier on the eyes, said the adverts
White — for the ones that drove a television tube

params.label: Screen hood
params.help: The brow moulded over the tube to keep the strip lights off it.

params.label: Screen tilt
params.help: How far the screen face leans back.

params.label: Vent slots
params.help: Down the sides and across the back, because the tube ran hot.

params.label: Built-in storage
params.help: What was moulded into the case beside or below the tube.

options.label: None — a port at the back and nothing else
Below the tube, across the front
Built into a shelf on the front

params.label: Expansion port for a disk unit

objects.name: Multimedia PC
objects.description: The 1995–2001 beige mini tower — sized from its board and bays, with a CD-ROM, a floppy, ISA and PCI cards side by side, and the speakers it was sold with.

params.label: Board
params.help: Sets the footprint, how tall the case has to be, and how many slots there are to fill.

options.label: Baby-AT — 216 × 330 mm, on its way out
ATX — 305 × 244 mm, ports in a block at the back

params.label: ISA cards
params.help: The sound card usually, and a modem if it was old enough.

params.label: PCI cards
params.help: Graphics, network, SCSI, or the sound card once it moved over.

params.label: Side panel off
params.help: Builds the board, the cards, the drive cage and the supply.

params.label: 5¼" openings
params.help: Each one is 41.3 mm of case height.

params.label: 3½" openings
params.help: 25.4 mm each. The floppy went in one of these.

params.label: Hard disks
params.help: In the internal cage, which adds 26 mm of height each.

params.label: Speakers
params.help: The pair that came in the box, one either side of the monitor.

objects.name: Notebook
objects.description: The 1995–2008 clamshell — sized by its panel and its keyboard, with a swappable drive bay, a PC Card slot and a battery under the back rather than bays and cards.

params.label: Panel
params.help: Diagonal. This is what the width of the machine comes from.

options.label: 16:9 — once panels came off television lines

params.label: Lid latch
params.help: The catch and the button that let it go. Later ones did without.

params.label: Key pitch
params.help: Full size is 19.05. Sub-notebooks went down to 16 and you noticed.

options.label: Pointing stick — between G, H and B

params.label: Palm rest
params.help: How much deck there is in front of the keys. This is most of the depth of the machine.

params.label: Swappable bay
params.help: One bay in the side, and you carried whatever else you needed in the bag.

params.label: Battery under the back
params.help: The cylinder pack that lifted the back of the machine and tilted the keyboard.

params.label: Base thickness
params.help: A drive bay in the side needs about 30 mm of it.

params.label: Status lamps
params.help: The little row of icons that told you the disk was busy.

objects.name: Rock
objects.description: A stone from pebble to boulder — fracture planes worn down by erosion, sedimentary bedding, an optional geode split open on its crystals, and moss on whatever faces the sky.

params.label: Size
params.help: Longest axis. Under 64 is a pebble, over 256 a boulder.

params.label: Stone
params.help: Colour, density, and how the stuff breaks — flint into few sharp faces, sandstone into many blunt ones.

params.label: Seed
params.help: Same seed, same stone.

params.label: Detail
params.help: How finely each face of the icosahedron it starts from is divided: 20 × (detail + 1)² faces, so six is 980 and twelve is 3,380.

params.label: Flatness
params.help: How squat it is. Few stones are round.

params.label: Elongation
params.help: Stretched along one axis.

params.label: Erosion
params.help: None is freshly fractured, all corners and flats. Full is river-tumbled: the corners go first and the fine detail with them.

params.label: Lumpiness
params.help: The slow swell of the surface.

params.label: Pitting
params.help: Fine roughness. Erosion wears this off first.

params.label: Bedding
params.help: Sedimentary layers, cut as ledges around the stone.

params.label: Cracked open
params.help: Splits it in two and opens the halves like a book. Nothing inside is built while it is shut.

params.label: Geode
params.help: A hollow lined with crystals. You only find out by breaking it.

params.label: Cavity
params.help: How much of the stone is hollow.

params.label: Crystal size
params.help: As a share of the cavity.

params.label: Banded lining
params.help: The agate rings between the shell and the hollow, which is how a geode fills in.

params.label: Moss
params.help: How much of the stone it has taken. It only grows on what faces the sky.

params.label: Down the sides
params.help: How far past the top it creeps.

objects.name: Shelf unit
objects.description: A simple carcass with evenly spaced shelves, sharing the same ledge profiles as the stair treads.

objects.name: Spiral staircase
objects.description: Wedge treads winding around a central column, with an optional helical handrail. The ledge profile wraps the full tread outline.

objects.name: Straight staircase
objects.description: A straight flight with a shaped tread nosing, optional risers, stringers and handrail. Riser height is derived from the floor-to-floor rise and the step count.

params.label: Width
params.help: Clear width across the treads.

params.label: Number of steps
params.help: Riser height = rise ÷ steps.

params.label: Going
params.help: Horizontal run of one step.

params.label: Tread at top floor
params.help: Off when the upper floor itself forms the last step.

params.label: Stringer depth
params.help: Measured vertically below the pitch line.

params.label: Rail height
params.help: Vertical distance above the nosing line.

objects.name: Table
objects.description: A table from a plan outline — six tops, moulded or banded edges, extension and drop leaves, six leg arrangements, and an ornament level that runs from plain board to turned and moulded.

params.label: Length
params.help: Along +X. The diameter or width across for the shapes with no separate width.

params.label: Height
params.help: Floor to top surface. 450 coffee, 750 dining, 900 counter, 1050 bar.

params.label: Edge profile
params.help: The same profiles the stair treads and shelves use, swept around the outline.

options.label: Banding — contrasting inlay around the field
Breadboard ends — cross pieces at each end
Raised lip — a gallery around the top

params.label: Leaves
params.help: Extension leaves drop into the middle and make the table longer; drop leaves are cut from the width and hinge down.

options.label: Extension leaves — inserted at the centre
Drop leaves — hinged along the sides

params.label: Leaf width
params.help: Along the length for extension leaves, across it for drop leaves.

options.label: Trestle — end frames and a stretcher

params.label: Taper to foot
params.help: Thickness left at the floor.

options.label: H — side rails and a centre rail
Box — a rail on all four sides

params.label: Apron
params.help: The rail running under the top between the legs.

params.label: Fanciness
params.help: 1 beads the apron, 2 arches it and pads the feet, 3 adds a moulding under the top, 4 corbels the legs, 5 collars the turnings and doubles the mouldings.
